global_similarity_negative_control.scope: Tensor factorization establishes these formulas for all positive n; no full 2^8192 matrix is constructed.
global_similarity_negative_control.consequence: A rooted bound does not imply a volume-uniform norm or condition number for the global creator exponential.

scope: Exact finite-dimensional examples and the explicit factorized negative-control family. No general M1 theorem, physical Hamiltonian equality, GNS identification, or excited-band completeness is certified by this script.
